what: The first B4 run applied the declared per-foot adhesion magnitude to every tarsus contact instead of sharing it across the foot's contacts, so a foot with five contacts received five times the declared force (logged peak_force 146.7 = 6.0 W, cap_hits 0).
why_kept: The prereg said per loaded foot, the implementation did per contact. That is a deviation and it is recorded rather than hidden. The corrected run enforces the cap per leg.

numbers_from_the_deviating_run.phase: release (3 s autonomous after 1 s assist)

note: these numbers came from the console output of that run; the JSON file was overwritten when the cap was fixed, so this record is a transcription, not the raw artifact
